name: 事件影响量表修订版
instructions: 以下问题涉及您对某个压力事件的反应。请根据过去一周的实际情况作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your reaction to a particular stressful event. Please answer according to your actual experience over the past week.
license: Weiss 等编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 任何与事件相关的回忆都会让我感到痛苦。
items.textEn: Any memory related to the event made me feel distressed.

items.text: 我难以入睡或保持睡眠。
items.textEn: I had trouble falling asleep or staying asleep.

items.text: 其他事情会让我想起那个事件。
items.textEn: Other things reminded me of the event.

items.text: 我感到烦躁和愤怒。
items.textEn: I felt irritable and angry.

items.text: 当我想起那个事件时，我会不自主地颤抖或出汗。
items.textEn: When I thought about the event, I would tremble or sweat involuntarily.

items.text: 我尽量不去想那个事件。
items.textEn: I tried not to think about the event.

items.text: 尽管已经过去，但事件的影响仍然存在。
items.textEn: Even though the event was already over, its impact was still there.

items.text: 我对事件相关的图片和声音很敏感。
items.textEn: I was very sensitive to images and sounds related to the event.

items.text: 我尽量保持忙碌，以免想起那个事件。
items.textEn: I tried to stay busy so I would not think about the event.

items.text: 事件相关的想法和感受会闯入我的脑海。
items.textEn: Thoughts and feelings about the event intruded into my mind.

items.text: 我感到情感麻木。
items.textEn: I felt emotionally numb.

items.text: 我觉得自己像是在重新经历那个事件。
items.textEn: I felt as though I were reliving the event.

items.text: 我难以集中注意力。
items.textEn: I had trouble concentrating.

items.text: 与事件相关的身体反应让我很困扰。
items.textEn: I was bothered by physical reactions related to the event.

items.text: 我会做噩梦，内容与事件相关。
items.textEn: I had dreams about the event.

items.text: 我对事件相关的活动或场景感到回避。
items.textEn: I avoided activities or situations related to the event.

items.text: 我感到容易受惊。
items.textEn: I felt easily startled.

items.text: 我尽量不谈论那个事件。
items.textEn: I tried not to talk about the event.

items.text: 事件相关的想法和感受让我无法放松。
items.textEn: Thoughts and feelings about the event kept me from relaxing.

items.text: 我对他人失去兴趣。
items.textEn: I lost interest in other people.

items.text: 我感到疏离或与他人隔绝。
items.textEn: I felt detached or cut off from other people.

items.text: 我难以体验积极情绪。
items.textEn: I had trouble experiencing positive feelings.

totalBands.description: 总分低于24，未达到临床创伤应激标准。
总分24-33，存在轻度创伤应激反应，建议关注。
总分33-44，存在中度创伤应激反应，建议寻求专业评估。
总分44及以上，存在重度创伤应激反应，建议尽快寻求专业帮助。
